purpose: Read-only confirmation of SAPL Natal nested pagination metadata for T-023/R23. No sync, PDF download, or database write was performed.
interpretation: The endpoint has a nested pagination.links.next contract and coherent page/total_entries/total_pages/start_index/end_index fields on the first three pages. The top-level count=1 and top-level next=null observed in the prior probe are not authoritative for this deployment. Returned continuation links use HTTP despite the HTTPS API endpoint; client code must validate host and API path, then upgrade the scheme to HTTPS before requesting. This bounded three-page sample does not certify a complete 936-page scan or authorize full sync.
side_effects: None. Three pages of public metadata were read with GET; no result payload text, PDF, credentials, or user data was stored; no import, sync, or database mutation occurred.
